raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "faker" %}
{% set version = "40.36.0" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/{{ name }}-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 754048c76c03afa7de83eee8f4bcee3cf668cbb7d995f54a4e9678db7f110308

build:
  entry_points:
    - faker=faker.cli:execute_from_command_line
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  number: 0

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - setuptools
    - pip
  run:
    - tzdata
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - python-tzdata

test:
  imports:
    - faker
  commands:
    - pip check
    - faker --help
  requires:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - pip

about:
  home: https://faker.readthedocs.io
  license: MIT
  license_family: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  summary: Faker is a Python package that generates fake data for you
  dev_url: https://github.com/joke2k/faker
  doc_url: https://faker.readthedocs.io

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - pmlandwehr
    - ocefpaf
